GuildMembers.label: Server members

health.offline: Bot offline or without access to the guild.
health.statusFailed: Could not get the bot status.
health.intentsHint: Privileged intents have to be enabled manually in the Discord Developer Portal.
health.needAdjustHint: Reinvite the bot to grant what is missing, the link comes with the permissions checked.

appeals.intro: Built-in appeal form (configurable) + review queue. The banned user opens it through the link sent by DM.

form.enabledHint: When on, the public page accepts submissions.
form.previewDm:
You were **banned** from the server **{guild}**.

**Reason:** Spam in chat
**Case:** #0042

To appeal, go to: {link}
form.previewHint: How the user receives the invite. The text comes from the DM template (Settings tab); the link goes wherever you put {token}.

review.approveHint: Approving does not undo the punishment automatically; revert the case in the Cases tab if needed.
review.approveDescription: Mark as approved. Remember to revert the case manually if you are releasing the user.

invite.description: Blocks invite links to other servers (discord.gg, etc). Local, instant detection.
invite.codesHint: Just the code (what comes after discord.gg/). E.g. your own server's invite.
invite.warnPlaceholder: Empty = default warning. Posted in the channel for ~8s.

ai.description: An AI (from the provider you choose) classifies messages in the monitored channels. The key is yours and stored encrypted.
ai.providerHint: {openrouter} unlocks every model. {custom} = an OpenAI API-compatible address (Ollama or your own server).
ai.apiKeySet: Configured (…{hint}), leave empty to keep it
ai.placeholderRules: Describe what counts as a violation (e.g. no politics, no unmarked spoilers...).
ai.placeholderOfftopic: What is this channel for? (helps the AI judge what is off-topic).
ai.placeholderToxicity: Optional, toxicity is already detected by default.

honeypot.savedPosted: Honeypot saved. Notice (re)posted in the channel.
honeypot.title: Honeypot (trap channel)
honeypot.description: Any message in the chosen channel {verb} the author immediately, catching compromised accounts that spam every channel. The bot posts an automatic notice in the channel. Admins/staff are always exempt.
honeypot.notPosted: The notice is posted when you save with the channel set.
honeypot.deleteRecentKick: Deletes the person's spam in every channel. To do so the bot bans and unbans right away, so they can come back through an invite. Needs the Ban Members permission; without it, it only kicks.
honeypot.deleteRecentBan: Deletes the person's spam in every channel at once, at the moment of the ban.
honeypot.warnPlaceholder: Empty = default notice, which mentions a ban. With kick or mute, write your own.

url.description: Blocks links in messages. Local, instant detection.
url.modeBlocklist: Block only domains on the list
url.hintAll: Only the domains here are allowed; any other link is blocked.
url.hintBlocklist: Covers subdomains (bit.ly covers x.bit.ly). Discord invites have their own filter above.

attachment.description: Blocks attachments by file extension (e.g. stops executables).
attachment.modeAllowlist: Allow only extensions on the list
attachment.extensionsPlaceholder: e.g. exe, bat, scr (no dot, comma-separated)
attachment.hintAllowlist: Only these extensions go through; any other attachment is blocked.
attachment.hintBlocklist: The list comes with dangerous extensions by default. Edit as you like.

autorole.intro: Roles applied automatically when a member joins. Useful for a "Visitor" role, gradual verification, or separating bots from humans.
autorole.empty: No rules. Click "New rule" to get started.

shared.reasonPlaceholder: Describe the reason for this case...

cases.searchHint: Type a name to search or paste a User ID (snowflake).
cases.title: Case history
cases.intro: Search by name or paste the user's Discord ID to see their whole moderation timeline.
cases.searchPlaceholder: Member name or user ID (e.g. troublemaker or 289124013375094794)
cases.empty: Search by name or paste a user ID above to see the cases.
cases.summary: {cases, plural, one {# case} other {# cases}} · {active, plural, one {# active} other {# active}}
cases.noCases: No cases, but you can still record notes and alt accounts in the dossier alongside.
cases.noMatch: No case matches the selected filters.

moderation.emptyDescription: Every ban, kick, mute or warning shows up here with a number.
moderation.noResultsDescription: Try another term or clear the filters.

new.softban: Softban (clears messages without keeping the ban)
new.targetRequired: The user's Discord ID is required.
new.title: New moderation action
new.targetHint: Right-click the user in Discord → “Copy User ID” (requires Developer Mode on).
new.durationHint: Discord's timeout goes up to 28 days (40320 min).

prune.noPermission: The bot lacks the required permissions in the channel (View Channel, Read Message History and Manage Messages).
prune.refused: Discord refused the deletions: messages already deleted, pinned, or insufficient permission.
prune.scanLimit: Nothing was deleted: the scan hit its limit before finding a message matching the filters.
prune.noMatch: Nothing was deleted: no message matched the filters.
prune.deletedPartial: {deleted, plural, one {# message deleted} other {# messages deleted}}, {rest, plural, one {# could not be deleted} other {# could not be deleted}}.
prune.deleted: {deleted, plural, one {# message deleted} other {# messages deleted}}.
prune.title: Clear messages, bulk delete
prune.oldHint: Messages older than 14 days are deleted one by one (slower); if the operation hits the time limit, run it again to continue.
prune.wouldDelete: {count, plural, one {# message would be deleted} other {# messages would be deleted}}

memberCounter.statsFailed: Could not get the live count.
memberCounter.saveFailed: Failed to save the member counter.
memberCounter.masterOff: The counter is {off}. Turn on {toggle} in {general}; while the main switch is off, the channel and the embed are not updated even with the surfaces enabled.
memberCounter.generalHint: Turns the module on and chooses which metrics show up on every surface.
memberCounter.enableHint: While off, nothing is updated in Discord.

stats.title: Stats channel (name)
stats.description: A voice channel whose name is renamed automatically with the count.
stats.channelHint: Voice channels work best: members don't join, they just read the name.
stats.intervalHint: Discord limits renames to ~2 every 10 min, minimum 10 min (600s).

desc.title: Description channel (topic)
desc.description: A text channel whose description/topic is updated with the count (up to 1024 characters, multi-line).
desc.intervalHint: Discord limits description edits to ~2 every 10 min, minimum 10 min (600s).

embed.title: Auto-updating embed
embed.description: An embed in a text channel, edited periodically with the count.
embed.enableHint: Save, then publish the embed in the chosen channel.
embed.publishedHint: Embed published, the bot updates it on the interval. Republishing recreates the message.
embed.notPublished: Not published yet. Save your changes before publishing.

live.title: Live preview
live.description: The current count as the bot sees it now (same source as the 3 surfaces).
live.cache: Bot offline, showing the last saved snapshot.

dossier.watchReason: Watch reason (e.g. repeat offender, uses alt accounts)
dossier.removeNoteDescription: This note and its attachments will be removed from the dossier.
dossier.invalidId: User ID must be a snowflake (17-20 digits).
dossier.altPlaceholder: User ID of the alt account
dossier.notePlaceholder: Record an observation about this user...

MESSAGE_DELETE.description: Logs when a message is deleted (in any monitored channel).

MESSAGE_EDIT.label: Message edited
MESSAGE_EDIT.description: Logs message edits with the before and after.

MEMBER_JOIN.label: Member joined
MEMBER_JOIN.description: Logs when someone joins the server.

MEMBER_LEAVE.label: Member left
MEMBER_LEAVE.description: Logs when someone leaves (kicks don't count, they go to Moderation actions).

MEMBER_BAN.label: Member banned
MEMBER_BAN.description: Logs any ban: honeypot, auto-moderation, command or manual ban done in Discord.

MEMBER_UNBAN.label: Member unbanned
MEMBER_UNBAN.description: Logs when a ban is revoked.

MEMBER_ROLE_UPDATE.label: Member roles
MEMBER_ROLE_UPDATE.description: When roles are added or removed. (Pro)

VOICE_JOIN_LEAVE_MOVE.label: Voice channels
VOICE_JOIN_LEAVE_MOVE.description: Voice channel joins, leaves and moves. (Pro)

logs.channelInherit: Back to inheriting the global channel.

logs.enableAll: Enable all in the global channel

overview.automodUnavailable: Could not read the protection settings right now.

purge.deletedStopped: {count, plural, one {# message deleted before stopping.} other {# messages deleted before stopping.}}
purge.nothing: Nothing was deleted: no messages from this user in the channels the bot can reach.
purge.stoppedWith: {count, plural, one {The cleanup stopped with # message already deleted. Run it again to continue.} other {The cleanup stopped with # messages already deleted. Run it again to continue.}}
purge.title: Delete a user's messages
purge.intro: Looks for the user's messages in every text, announcement and voice chat channel and active thread, and deletes them the same way as Clear messages: recent ones in bulk, those older than 14 days one by one. Works for people who already left the server. On a large server it takes minutes.
purge.found: {count, plural, one {# message found} other {# messages found}}
purge.deletedCount: {count, plural, one {# message deleted} other {# messages deleted}}
purge.skipped: {count, plural, one {# channel skipped: the bot lacks View Channel, Read Message History or Manage Messages there.} other {# channels skipped: the bot lacks View Channel, Read Message History or Manage Messages there.}}
purge.failed: {count, plural, one {# could not be deleted: already removed, pinned or no permission.} other {# could not be deleted: already removed, pinned or no permission.}}

selectors.title: Roles by reaction, button or list
selectors.intro: Selectors for members to pick roles on their own, via reaction, button or dropdown. Each selector posts a message in the chosen channel.
selectors.empty: No selectors. Click "New selector" to get started.
selectors.unpublishDescription: Its message in the channel is deleted.
selectors.deleteDescription: The message posted in the channel is deleted too.
selectors.verifySingle: Verification mode uses a single option, the click is final.
selectors.optionIncomplete: Every option needs a label + role.
selectors.durationHint: {duration}, the role is removed when the time is up.
selectors.verifyWarning: Verification mode uses a single option. Remove the others to save, or switch back to Free mode.
selectors.label: Label

modlog.title: Modlog (moderation log channels)
modlog.description: Two separate channels: the public one only shows "so-and-so was banned", with no reason; the internal one has the reason, who applied it and everything staff needs for auditing.
modlog.publicHint: Visible to regular members. Empty = no public log.

modactions.description: DM on punishment, raid mode and appeal link.
modactions.dmHint: Sends a DM with the action + reason before applying it. Fails silently if DMs are blocked.
modactions.raidHint: When on, new members go through extra verification before joining. Turn it on during mass attacks on the server.

dossier.title: Dossier
dossier.description: Settings for the history of problem users.
dossier.watchRoleHint: Applied in Discord when you mark a user "on watch" in the dossier, and removed when you unmark them. Empty = no role applied.

settings.dmPreviewHint: How the user receives the DM. The appeal link goes wherever you put {token}.

appeal.title: Appeal link in the DM
appeal.hint: Sent in the punished user's DM (wherever {token} is).
appeal.internalHint: Uses the built-in form. Set up the questions and turn it on in the {tab} tab.

dm.usingDefaults: Using the default (all on). Click to turn off the DM for certain actions.

welcome.testSent: Test message sent to the channel.
welcome.embedMentionHint: Mentions inside an embed don't notify: to ping whoever joined, keep {token} in the plain text above the embed.
